title: Sensitive value in log call (python) — review required
description: A python log call outputs a value named like a credential: print("pw=" + password). Logs persist, replicate, and are read by operators and tools that must never see secrets. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms the value is non-sensitive or redacts it.
remediation: Stop logging the value; log presence flags or redacted markers instead, and scrub historic logs that already hold it.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches credential-adjacent names in log calls regardless of actual content.
